rationale: Extends Nina's 3/16/22 Route-97 lead into the scouting week: shows Clearwater sits outside the GreenAcre batch that had just returned (039), that Priya pushes the Klamath adds for pipeline while Tom knows four of the eight need another look, and that county filings were requested only after the site walk. Feeds the Arc J join (lead date vs later option dates) without characterizing intent; no KW labels yet (options come 3/29, EMAIL-413).

messages.body:
Thanks Nina — got the pins. Before I lock the route, can you get me three things from the owner: the entity name on title, what they think the combined acreage is, and whether there's anything already recorded on it (easement, lease, anything). I'd rather not drive down there and find out it's tied up.

I can do Tuesday the 22nd in that corridor. Wednesday is already the other two parcels near Chiloquin.

Title is in Clearwater Land LLC — the owner I've been talking to is the managing member. Two adjoining parcels, both off 97 south of the junction.

On acreage, he quoted me a number off an old listing sheet and I wouldn't lean on it. He wasn't sure what's recorded; he thinks there was a grazing lease that lapsed years ago but couldn't say if anything was released. Probably worth pulling the filings before anyone gets excited.

He's around Tuesday afternoon if you want to walk it with him.

Looping Priya in. Priya — Nina has a motivated owner with two adjoining parcels off Route 97 in Klamath County. Early days, nothing on paper, but they'd be new adds rather than anything in the current batch. I'm walking them Tuesday.

Good find, Nina. Two questions. What's realistic timing to get options signed if Tuesday goes well — could these make the Q2 pipeline? And are these part of what GreenAcre is already looking at, or would they need their own survey?

We're light for Q2 against what Elena's team is expecting, so anything that can be papered in April helps.

Taking Nina off this one. GreenAcre came back Tuesday on the eight — these two weren't in that scope, so they'd need their own survey. Separately, four of the eight came back with reported acreage above the county filings. I flagged that to you on the 2nd and it's now in writing from them. I want to understand it before we lean on those numbers.

For the Klamath pair, I'd get options papered first and then ask GreenAcre for a quote. Options in April is doable if the owner's counsel is quick.

Understood on the eight — send me GreenAcre's findings and let's go through them next week, not over email. I don't want the Klamath adds slowed down while we sort that out; they're separate parcels. Get the options drafted when you're back and we'll figure out survey sequencing after.

Owner confirmed Tuesday at 2 at the north gate. He'll have his listing sheet and whatever old paperwork he can find. I asked about the grazing lease again — he'll look for a release.

Priya, on timing: he wants to move, so if Tom brings a draft option he'd likely sign within a couple of weeks. His lawyer is in Klamath Falls.
2 at the north gate works. Thanks Nina.

Walked both parcels with him this afternoon. Access is off a county road plus a ranch track on the south parcel; the north one is mostly open ground and looks like it fits the siting criteria. He didn't find the lease release — he thinks the county would have it.

He wants an option drafted quickly and asked when the first payment would come. I told him standard terms and that nothing moves until we've seen the filings. Recorder's office was closed by the time we finished (you called it — 4pm), so I'll get Hannah to request them.

Hannah — can you request the county filings for the two Clearwater parcels below (Klamath County, off Route 97)? Mainly looking for acreage of record and anything recorded against them — there may be an old grazing lease. Nina can get you the parcel numbers from the owner.

Hi Tom, happy to. Klamath usually turns requests around in about a week by mail, faster if someone picks up in person. I'll need the parcel numbers to submit, not just the road description. Once I have them I'll open a file for the pair so the filings sit with the other Coastal Solar parcel records.

Should these be copied to the same folder as the Northwest batch, or kept separate?

Keep them separate — they're not part of the Northwest batch and they won't be in GreenAcre's work on the eight. Copying Nina, who's getting the parcel numbers from the owner today. Nina, please send those straight to Hannah.
